body:
Completed with published evidence at `7f293a22d97317d1632952a5cf2e9d4a45bd2cb2` and qualified candidate `ee014909137e03706e0b3020b8396be589aaa705`. The offline validator now requires the actual pointers field and empty root, all three downloaded hashes, unsupported flag, unchanged original snapshots and verified four-result/seal/cleanup evidence. Missing/wrong-root controls fail. The original validator failure is retained; the four passing VM cases were not replayed.

[Final audit record](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/7f293a22d97317d1632952a5cf2e9d4a45bd2cb2/docs/audits/2026_10_06-milestone-m7-p4-fixes-383/08-installed-resolution.md). Device testing and release publication retain their separate gates.
